concerns.text: The plan uses the “Long‑Context QA (Long‑QA)” dataset (`https://huggingface.co/datasets/llamaindex/long-qa`) as the downstream evaluation benchmark and then filters it to contexts ≥ 32 k tokens. The Long‑QA dataset is not documented to contain such ultra‑long contexts; after filtering it may yield very few or zero examples, which would undermine the QA evaluation (FR‑007) and the associated success criteria (SC‑004). Verify that the chosen dataset actually provides a sufficient number of ≥ 32 k‑token QA instances, or replace it with a verified long‑context QA benchmark (e.g., a filtered subset of HotpotQA or NarrativeQA) that satisfies the length requirement.
